_comment: Content patch applied to siteContent/current by scripts/import-firestore-content.mjs. Every benefit here is a byproduct of something the team already produces — no new artifact, no recurring commitment, no event to organise. Escalation is by prominence, not by workload.

items.title: Bronze
benefits: Logo on our website sponsorship wall
Thank-you post naming you across our social media
Logo in our season engineering portfolio, read by FIRST judges

items.title: Silver
benefits: Logo on the pit banner we display at every competition
A dedicated social post about your support, with photos from the season

items.title: Gold
benefits: Logo on the robot and on the team shirts we wear all season
Standing invitation to any competition, with a pit tour and a look at the robot

items.title: Platinum
benefits: Presenting sponsor — named first and largest everywhere we list sponsors
An end-of-season email with our results, photos, and where your money went
